verdicts.reason: A5 fails: checkRunnable is true but the check depends on fixtures/markets-print/check.py, a repo program the registry does not list and this verifier cannot confirm exists, so true is unproven (A1-A4 hold: exit code, reliable only because the release is the locked input, eps/guidance/surprise each quoted with a line, absent counts as a pass).
A3 fails: the brief requires recording the page or item, but the program only greps the quote in the extracted text and never checks the page or item locator, so a wrong locator still passes.

All rules hold: the check is a program that confirms each quote in its own source, filing and news lines stay separately labelled with an agree/disagree/unplaced verdict, status is assisted as in the brief, unplaced is a valid result, and checkRunnable false is honest.
A3 fails: the human-only done-when checks the thesis and an observable kill condition but leaves out two things the brief names, separating fact from inference and having no order and no size.

A3 and A1 fail: the git diff check never makes the kill condition stay in view (deleting it reads as a removed line), and telling expired removals from other changes, or a delta from a whole-card rewrite, takes a judgment the diff alone cannot make.

A3 fails: the state diff enforces one changed key with the others byte-equal, but no program checks that the thesis is shown under the move or that output stops after that variable, both named in the brief.
